title: നിങ്ങളുടെ Broker Genuine ആണോ? 🔍 SEBI Registration Check | Day 10 #shorts
description:
The Stoic Bull | Stock Market Zero to Hero, Day 10! Account തുറക്കും മുൻപ് broker SEBI-registered ആണോ എന്ന് sebi.gov.in-ൽ check ചെയ്യൂ. Guaranteed returns, personal account-ലേക്ക് പണം, WhatsApp tips: ഇവ red flags ആണ്.

How to check if your stock broker is registered: search SEBI's list of registered intermediaries on sebi.gov.in and match the name and registration number.

⚠️ Educational content only. Not investment advice. We are not SEBI-registered advisers.

#shorts #sebi #stockbroker #fraudalert #stockmarket #malayalam #thestoicbull
